name: QG-I2013: After an underwriter rejects an application, its earlier email links allow no action
description:
Objective: QG-I2013: After an underwriter rejects an application, its earlier email links allow no action.
Preconditions: Open Bug regressions application with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Bug regressions application.
2. QG-I2013: After an underwriter rejects an application, its earlier email links allow no action.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Each stage runs on its own automation application: drive it to the stage, collect the links its emails carried, reject it as the underwriter, then open every link. None may still allow an action.
